title: Enterprise security triage playbook for complex vendor questionnaires
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create an operational playbook and decision matrix for triaging incoming enterprise security and compliance requests (vendor questionnaires, SOC2/ISO attestations, HIPAA questions, GDPR/DPA requirements) received via support, sales, and onboarding. The playbook will: 1) categorize requests by complexity and legal/regulatory domain, 2) define SLAs and routing rules for Sales, Solutions, Security Engineering, and Legal, 3) provide templated responses and minimum evidence bundles (SOC2 report, data flow diagrams, encryption/HSM attestations, DPA wording), 4) outline gating criteria for Dedicated/Private deployments, and 5) include a prioritization rubric that balances customer revenue, technical friction, and compliance risk. This initiative aims to reduce time-to-respond for complex questionnaires from weeks to days, reduce repeated ad-hoc engineering effort, and give Sales predictable commit windows for enterprise deals.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Playbook published in Confluence with a clear decision tree and routing rules. 2) Three templated evidence bundles (SOC2, GDPR/DPA, HIPAA) reviewed and signed off by Security and Legal. 3) Intake form updated to categorize complexity and trigger the correct SLA (auto-tagging for SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA). 4) Two pilot customers' questionnaires processed using the playbook within SLA. 5) Runbook handed to Solutions Engineering and CS with a training session scheduled.
